issues.quote: Net income was one hundred twenty-seven point three billion dollars
issues.problem: Microsoft's FY2025 net income was about $101.8 billion, not $127.3 billion. $127.3B is also implausible because it is nearly equal to the $128.5B operating income.

data.summary: Revenue, growth rate, operating income, total assets and cash are correct. Net income is overstated: it was about $101.8B, not $127.3B.
